evidence.caveat: This comparison cannot determine whether the care provided met the standard of practice without reviewing the actual clinical records and the rationale behind the decisions made.

draft.details:
On 2026-09-12, I fell on my outstretched right hand at the Emergency Department, Royal Victoria Hospital, Belfast. I was X-rayed and told there was no fracture, just a sprain, and I was sent home with no follow-up. The pain continued. On 2026-10-09, another scan showed a scaphoid fracture that has not healed, and I now need surgery. I have missed coursework and shifts at my café job. I would like an explanation of why I had no MRI or follow-up X-ray, an apology, a learning review, and information on compensation.

Department of Health Northern Ireland / NICE says: "Consider MRI for first-line imaging in people with suspected scaphoid fractures following a thorough clinical examination." Could Belfast Health and Social Care Trust please explain how this recommendation was considered in my care?
draft.location: Emergency Department, Royal Victoria Hospital, Belfast
draft.outcome: An explanation of why I had no MRI or follow-up X-ray, an apology, a learning review, and information on compensation
